title: Batch processing
loadFailed: The batches could not be loaded.
empty: No batches. Pick a table (or import a CSV), then start your first run.

modal.title: New batch
modal.name: Batch name
modal.importHint: The CSV becomes a new table of the workspace. Rows arrive within seconds: wait until their count shows.
modal.importFailed: The CSV could not be imported.
modal.templateHint: Cite columns between double braces, for example {example}. Rows whose cited columns are empty are skipped.
modal.templatePlaceholder: Classify this review as positive, negative or neutral: {example}
modal.columnHint: Each row's answer is written there. Letters, digits and underscores (accents are removed).
modal.maxTokensHint: A classification needs few tokens: a low value speeds a local model up noticeably. Empty: no cap.
modal.maxTokensInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 8192, or leave empty.
modal.failed: The batch could not be started.

detail.loadFailed: This batch could not be loaded.
detail.confirmCancelBody: Requests in progress are interrupted and the remaining rows will not be processed. Answers already written in the table stay.
detail.confirmDeleteBody: The batch's tracking and results are deleted. Answers already written in the table stay.
detail.context: {model} · {source} · {concurrency, plural, one {# request at a time} other {# requests at a time}}
detail.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row skipped (empty text)} other {# rows skipped (empty text)}}
detail.resultsNote: The first {count} rows are shown; the CSV export holds the whole batch.
